clause.displayText: Institution type must be Government, Government-aided, or approved private

source_text: Candidates must meet family income limits (₹4 lakh/year for salaried, ₹2.5 lakh/year for others), age limit (max 30 years), and be studying in Government, Government-aided, or approved private institutions with non-exorbitant fees
